Operating activities

The Operating Activities section of the cash flow statement shows cash flows from your primary business operations.

Operating activities include cash received from customers, cash paid to suppliers and employees, and other cash flows related to your core business activities.

Purpose

Operating activity groups help organize and present cash flows in a meaningful way on your cash flow statement.

Common operating activities include cash receipts from sales, cash payments for inventory, wages, rent, and other operating expenses.

Creating Groups

Click the New Group button to create custom groupings that match your business needs.

Each group will appear as a separate line item in the operating activities section of your cash flow statement.

Name
Name

Displays the name of each operating activity group that you have created.

This name will appear as a line item heading in the operating activities section of your cash flow statement.
